review_notes: I read all 120 lines. A grep for def, structure, class, abbrev and instance found none of them. The file contains only lemmas and theorems: lowJet_increment_eq_variation, lowJet_increment_position, weighted_increment_unscaled, slow_increment_C3, slow_increment_lowJet, slow_increment_ratio, slow_increment_C3_ratio, primitive_slow_increment_bounds and primitive_slow_increment_derivative. They use concepts defined in other files (WeightedBound, lowJet, variationLowJet, planeCoordinateIsometry) but do not define any new concept, representation or API that could compete with Mathlib, Lean core or Batteries. The rpow helper lemmas slow_increment_ratio and slow_increment_C3_ratio are short algebraic rewrites. Even if they overlap with existing Mathlib facts, that would be standalone theorem duplication or proof shortening, which this rubric explicitly excludes. So the file has nothing this rubric can target. Whether the imported concepts duplicate Mathlib should be judged in the files that define them, not here.
